name: dsh-svg
description: DSH host plugin: rasterize SVG to PNG inside the Harness (resvg / rsvg-convert / sharp) and hand the picture straight back to the model, plus a static SVG linter for the classic LLM-SVG mistakes (LaTeX residue, baseline-shift, per-character <text>, external fonts).

meta.title: SVG 渲染 / 体检
meta.description: svg_render 把 SVG 栅格化成 PNG 并把图直接交给模型（画完能看见）；svg_check 静态体检并自动修复常见坑。
